entries.title: Market Sectors Foundation
entries.description: Introduced market sectors with correlated stock movements for more realistic trading experience.
changes: Added 6 market sectors: Technology, Automotive, Financial Services, Retail, Entertainment, Healthcare
Stock prices now influenced by both individual trends (70%) and sector trends (30%)
Sector-wide correlations create realistic market behavior patterns
Enhanced market simulator with comprehensive sector tracking
Database schema updated to support sector relationships and crisis management
Fixed critical infinity errors that could crash the trading system
Improved WebSocket message handling with sanitization
Added changelog system with automatic popup notifications

entries.title: Authentication & UI Improvements
entries.description: Enhanced user experience with better authentication flow and loading states.
changes: Fixed login redirect issues after successful authentication
Improved loading spinner animations and removed problematic circular spinner
Enhanced error handling with global ErrorBoundary component
Added comprehensive diagnostic logging for better debugging
Fixed navigation layer z-index conflicts
Streamlined Discord OAuth integration

entries.title: Initial Release Stability
entries.description: Core trading platform with essential features for multiplayer stock market simulation.
changes: Real-time stock trading with portfolio management
WebSocket-based live price updates every 2 seconds
User authentication and registration system
Leaderboard rankings and portfolio tracking
Transaction history and detailed analytics
Real-time chat system for community interaction
Admin panel for game management and controls
Mobile-responsive design for all devices
